newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Metroplex in S. African venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Metroplex in S. African venture.

text.p: Metroplex Bhd said on Monday it has entered into a memorandum of understanding with three firms to set up a joint venture for the purpose of investing and developing opportunities in the leisure industry of South Africa.
The three companies -- Worldwide African Investment Holdings (Pty) Ltd, Three Cities Hotels (Pty) Ltd and Carlton Add-Ventures Holdings (Pty) Ltd -- are all incorporated in South Africa.
Worldwide is an investment holding company while Three Cities is the operator of a hotel group in South Africa.

Add-Ventures, owned by Worldwide and Three Cities, is presently redeveloping the Carlton Centre complex into a major entertainment and international conference centre that would include hotel, convention, shopping, entertainment and casino facilities.

The proposed joint venture is expected to manage the Carlton Centre Casino as part of its bid for one of the casino licences to be awarded in the province of Gauteng, South Africa, Metroplex said in a statement.
Metroplex presently operates casinos in the Philippines and Australia.
